//: Composite indexes the map library needs. Firestore builds single-field
indexes on its own, but a query that filters on one field and orders by
another needs one of these declared, and until it exists that query fails.
Each one is here because of a specific query in stellar-command.html:
public + rnd        libRandom  - a slice of public maps from a random key
public + nameLower  libSearch  - prefix search over public maps
owner  + createdAt  libMine    - your own, newest first
Apply with the Firebase CLI:  firebase deploy --only firestore:indexes
Or create the three by hand in Firestore - Indexes - Composite, with the
fields and directions below. The console also offers a one-click link in
the browser console the first time each query runs.
